## Checklist

- [ ] A test was written first and failed before the change.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] New rules: a positive case in every context, a placeholder case, a negative case and a slow input case.
- [ ] No real credential anywhere in the change. Test values are built from parts.
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md has a line under Unreleased.
